runs.content: AbbVie picked up at today's previous close ($265.21) — momentum screen (+25.27% 3mo), ECLIPSE Phase 3 migraine trial hit its primary endpoint (Sept 11), RBC reiterated Buy the same day, 30-analyst Buy consensus; defensive-healthcare pick on a broad risk-off day (10Y Treasury yield at its highest since July 2007) where gold miners (NEM −4.18%, FCX −3.33%) fell on the same hawkish-Fed catalyst that ruled out the Materials/Sector-Rotation alternative. NVO was exited discretionarily (−11.56%, −$116) on thesis-deterioration grounds — Novo's Sept 21 Capital Markets Day disappointed on 2030 growth targets and confirmed CagriSema trial setbacks — freeing capacity for ABBV and holding the book at 35 open positions. HUM crossed −10.48% WATCH today, no Burry conflict, held per Step 3D. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,470 (+2.26% on $65,000).

International Consolidated Airlines Group picked up at today's previous close (430.30 GBX, ~$5.75) — deep value screen (P/E 7.43, earnings yield 19.36%, ROIC 27.47%), benefiting from crude at an 11-day low (its largest cost line), H1 2026 revenue/margin/cash flow all improved. EVTC was exited discretionarily (−6.52%, −$65) to keep the book at 35 open positions after IAG's entry — HUM and OTIS were both passed over despite weaker P&L on fresh positive-thesis grounds. CRWD hit T2 today (+50.33%, $249.35) — second 1/3 sold, final 1/3 runs uncapped; NVO crossed −10.66% WATCH, no Burry conflict, held. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,484 (+2.32% on $64,000).
